languages: : English, Hindi, Kannada, and Urdu PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Company- Senior Lead – Internal Audit & SOX, Grant Thornton INDUS Date: October 2024-December 2024 Country: India Spearheaded independent audit assignments for global clients, focusing on critical supply chain and logistics operations. Evaluated internal controls and operational risks for material handling, dispatch scheduling, and inventory logistics. Applied data analytics using SAP ERP and Excel to validate the accuracy of process records and support audit conclusions. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to understand workflows and design practical, control-focused recommendations. Prepared audit documentation, including risk matrices, narratives, and executive-level memos, in line with regulatory standards. Company- Senior Associate – SOX & CCAP, JP Morgan Chase & Co Date: May 2023-July 2024 Country: India Performed

end-to-end SOX 404 testing and CCAP controls assessment for financial reporting processes across PTP, OTC, Inventory, and Payroll functions. Conducted control walkthroughs, evaluated design and operating effectiveness, and collaborated on remediation plans for identified gaps. Prepared narratives, RCMs, and control documentation aligned with COSO framework. Utilized Alteryx to automate audit procedures, extract patterns, and perform exception analysis in large datasets. Worked closely with internal stakeholders and control owners to ensure continuous improvement and compliance alignment. Company- Audit and Finance Manager, Bangalore Blues Entertainment India Private Limited Date: November 2022-April 2023 Country: India Led internal audits for a fast-growing hospitality chain, focusing on revenue assurance, vendor payments, and procurement controls. Designed and implemented control mechanisms to strengthen financial governance across outlets and central finance operations. Conducted cost analysis and identified opportunities for improving operational efficiency. Developed SOPs for finance processes and collaborated with operations teams to ensure process adherence.

Utilized Excel and manual reconciliation to validate cash handling, POS billing, and inventory reporting. Company- Audit & Compliance Manager, R Vijayanand Chartered Accountant Date: October 2017-November 2022 Country: India Conducted internal audits and SOX readiness for IT, hospitality, and energy clients. Evaluated process controls and compliance over fuel inventory, dispatch tracking, storage facilities, and revenue recording within the energy sector. Reviewed financial statements, tested control environments, and provided risk mitigation suggestions tailored to industry-specific challenges. Drafted audit reports, maintained work papers, and supported external audit coordination across multiple engagements. Company- Articled Assistant, KEN & Co Date: September 2014-September 2017 Country: India Assisted in audits across hospitals, manufacturing, export, and banking industries. Conducted internal audit reviews of export companies, focusing on documentation controls, vendor payments, stock movements, and compliance with foreign trade regulations. Evaluated ICFR, prepared audit documentation, and supported compliance reviews.

scope areas: General Auditor: Governance Risk Management Corporate	Strategic	Planning and Performance Management Finance Human Resources Procurement and Contracts The candidate has experience in executing below roles: Governance – Reviewed the governance structure of energy sector clients, including board reporting lines, delegation of authority, and policy compliance. Assessed the effectiveness of oversight mechanisms and internal control frameworks to ensure alignment with corporate governance standards and regulatory expectations. Risk Management – Performed risk assessments at both entity and process levels, identifying control weaknesses and potential compliance gaps in areas such as procurement, inventory, and revenue. Mapped risks to business objectives and recommended mitigation strategies aligned with COSO and ICFR frameworks. Corporate Strategic Planning & Performance Management – Audited budgeting and performance monitoring processes, assessing alignment between strategic plans and operational execution. Reviewed KPIs, variance reports, and forecasting accuracy to ensure effective performance management and informed decision-making by leadership teams. Finance – Conducted detailed audits of financial processes including PTP, OTC, Payroll, Fixed Assets, and

General Ledger. Performed SOX control testing, walkthroughs, and financial data validations using SAP and Excel analytics to ensure financial integrity and reporting accuracy. Human Resources – Evaluated HR and payroll controls covering employee onboarding, master data maintenance, payroll processing, and statutory compliance. Verified access controls and approvals in SAP systems, ensuring policy adherence and segregation of duties. Procurement & Contracts – Audited end-to-end procurement and contract management cycles, from vendor selection to payment processing. Reviewed contract terms, pricing controls, tender documentation, and approval workflows to ensure compliance, transparency, and cost control. P

Prior experience in Engineering Audit in the Energy Sector for Category 2 The relevant qualification and experience are required to cover the following audit scope areas: Technical Auditor: Supply	Chain	and	Materials Management Inventory and Warehouse Production and Operations Process Safety Maintenance Asset Integrity Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Engineering Management Measurement and Metering Laboratory Operations Investments	and	Project Management Behavioral Good judgment and analytical skills (big picture) Please provide examples. The candidate has demonstrated strong analytical skills in conducting control evaluations, trend analysis, and root cause assessments to identify and address process inefficiencies and control failures. His ability to assess the bigger picture has consistently supported effective decision-making and process improvements. Examples: Identified unexplained variances in inventory records. Leveraged SAP and Excel trend analysis to uncover over-reporting caused by manual consolidation errors. Recommended an automated reconciliation tracker, which improved accuracy and reporting reliability. Detected inconsistencies in POS revenue and cash handling. Used Excel-based reconciliations and trend

comparisons across multiple locations. Findings led to implementation of standardized cash-handling SOPs and stronger oversight controls. While testing procurement controls, identified frequent control failures in 3-way match due to duplicate vendor entries. Used Alteryx and Excel to analyze vendor master data, and recommended central approval controls, reducing duplication and improving compliance. During control testing, identified recurring exceptions in approval workflows. Analyzed large datasets to isolate non-compliant patterns and traced them to system design flaws. Recommendations helped enhance workflow configurations and reduce future control failures. M

Behavioral Strong organizational skills (scheduling meetings, adequate and timely working papers). Please elaborate / provide examples. The candidate has demonstrated excellent organizational skills in managing audit workflows, stakeholder coordination, documentation, and timely delivery of audit evidence. His ability to prioritize, structure tasks, and manage deadlines has contributed to smooth audit execution and effective collaboration. Examples: Walkthrough Coordination:

Successfully scheduled and conducted 30 walkthrough meetings over a 3-month period during peak audit season. Coordinated across multiple stakeholders in different time zones, ensured timely follow-ups, and documented each session through meeting minutes and completed checklists, all aligned with internal audit standards. Audit Documentation Management:

Managed multiple audit engagements simultaneously by maintaining timely and well-structured working papers. Ensured accurate version control, adhered to internal review timelines, and prevented last-minute escalations by organizing planning, execution, and reporting phases efficiently. Stakeholder Communication & Tracking:

Maintained audit trackers, scheduled interviews and follow-ups with process owners, and monitored status updates across multiple workstreams. This ensured all key milestones and deliverables were met without compromising audit quality or deadlines. M Behavioral Ability to work independently with minimum instructions and supervision from the Lead Auditor. Has (s)he led many assignments before? Size of assignments that were led. The candidate has consistently demonstrated the ability to work independently with minimal supervision from the Lead Auditor. The candidate has successfully led full-cycle audit engagements, showing ownership in planning, execution, and reporting. His proactive approach has enabled him to meet or exceed corporate deadlines while maintaining audit quality. Examples: End-to-End Audit Leadership:

Led multiple internal audits and SOX assignments covering 8 to 12 business processes. Managed the entire audit cycle independently—including planning, walkthroughs, testing, issue identification, and reporting—while coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure timely deliverables. Independent SOX Control Testing:

Independently tested 40–50 controls across PTP, OTC, Inventory, and Payroll business cycles. Performed walkthroughs, documented control effectiveness, and handled exceptions without needing regular oversight. Consistently delivered testing outputs ahead of corporate deadlines. Stakeholder Management & Execution:

Handled scheduling, data requests, and communication with process owners directly. Maintained audit documentation and evidence with minimal review cycles required, reflecting high levels of trust from senior auditors and audit managers. Multi-Client Audit Deliver:

Simultaneously managed audit engagements for clients in logistics and renewable energy sectors. Balanced competing priorities, ensured consistency in documentation, and delivered high-quality reports within tight timelines—demonstrating strong independence and sector-specific audit expertise. M Competence Very good expertise in Data Analytics techniques. Please	provide	details/examples	of expertise. The candidate has demonstrated strong expertise in data analytics by leveraging tools such as Excel (Power Query, Pivot Tables), SAP ERP, and Alteryx to support audit planning, control testing, and risk identification. The candidate has applied analytics techniques to drive efficiency, detect anomalies, and improve audit quality across key business processes. Examples: Control Testing Automation:
Used Alteryx and Excel to automate SOX control testing across PTP and Payroll cycles, enabling faster identification of exceptions and reducing manual testing efforts. Exception & Pattern Analysis:

Applied Power Query and Pivot Table techniques in Excel to analyze large datasets for trends and outliers in vendor payments, inventory variances, and approval workflows, enhancing the depth of audit coverage. Duplicate Vendor Detection:

Utilized Alteryx workflows to identify duplicate vendor payments during control testing. The findings helped stakeholders correct master data issues and strengthen preventive controls in the procurement process. SAP Data Extraction & Validation:

Extracted key data from SAP modules (MM, FI) to validate transactions related to inventory movement and fixed asset capitalization. This helped in reconciling system entries with supporting documents and identifying process gaps. P Competence Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel Provide examples in support of response. The candidate has demonstrated advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel through the development and use of automation tools, analytical models, and data validation techniques to support audits, testing, and reporting. His expertise includes Power Query, Pivot Tables, INDEX-MATCH, VLOOKUP, conditional formatting, and dashboard creation. Examples: Audit Testing & Sampling Automation:
Developed Excel-based templates using Power Query and formulas to automate audit sampling and control testing processes, improving efficiency and reducing manual errors. Exception & Trend Analysis:

Used Pivot Tables and dynamic formulas to identify payment exceptions, inventory variances, and approval delays across large datasets, supporting data-driven audit insights. Inventory Reconciliation Tool:

Built a Power Query-based reconciliation model to track inventory movements across warehouse locations. This tool enabled real-time variance tracking and significantly reduced manual effort in audits. Dashboard Reporting & Data Validation:

Created Excel dashboards with data validation tools and conditional formatting to present key audit findings to stakeholders in a clear and actionable format, enhancing report quality and usability. P Competence Good knowledge and use of SAP ERP system The candidate has demonstrated strong working knowledge of the SAP ERP system, using it effectively for audit planning, walkthroughs, control testing, and data validation. His experience includes extracting and analyzing transactional data across key business cycles such as PTP, Inventory, and Fixed Assets to identify process gaps and improve audit outcomes. Examples: Audit Walkthrough & Control Testing:

Used SAP to extract transaction logs, approval history, and audit trails during walkthroughs and SOX testing. Verified control effectiveness for procurement and asset-related processes. Fixed Asset Review:

Reviewed asset capitalization and depreciation entries through SAP reports. Identified incorrect asset class mappings and flagged inconsistencies in depreciation runs, leading to improved financial reporting accuracy. Inventory Movement Analysis:

Analyzed stock transfers and goods receipt data in SAP to track inventory movement. Identified delays and mismatches between physical and system records, which were addressed through process improvements. Vendor Payment and PO Matching:

Validated PTP transactions using SAP’s invoice and PO matching features. Helped identify duplicate payments and approval gaps, contributing to stronger compliance in procurement controls. P Communication Strong written and oral communication skills (in English). This includes the ability to prepare high quality Audit Memos with recommendations. Provide examples of types of reports prepared. The candidate has demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills through the preparation and presentation of high-quality audit documentation, reports, and recommendations. His communication style ensures clarity, precision, and impact across all levels of the organization. Examples: Audit Memos and Reports:

Prepared detailed audit memos highlighting control design gaps and operational inefficiencies, particularly in PTP and Inventory processes. These memos included clear issue descriptions, root cause analysis, and practical recommendations, and were well-received by senior management. Walkthrough Documentation and RCMs:
Developed walkthrough narratives and Risk & Control Matrices (RCMs) with clear control descriptions and test procedures, ensuring alignment with COSO and SOX frameworks. Executive-Level Reporting:

Drafted summary reports and dashboards tailored for senior stakeholders, effectively communicating audit findings, risk exposure, and management action plans to support decision-making and remediation efforts. M Communication Excellent interpersonal and interviewing skills, including the ability to interact with all levels of management and employees. Provide examples of levels of management and employees that have been interacted with in the past. The candidate has demonstrated excellent interpersonal and interviewing skills through effective collaboration, clear communication, and the ability to build rapport across all levels of the organization. His approach facilitates open dialogue and enables the collection of valuable insights during audit engagements. Examples: Control Walkthroughs and Process Interviews:

Independently conducted over 30 walkthrough meetings during a large-scale SOX engagement, interacting with process owners, department heads, and finance leads. Extracted key process insights to evaluate control design and operating effectiveness. Multi-Level Stakeholder Interaction:

Engaged with a wide range of personnel including CFOs, Financial Controllers, Internal Audit Heads, Plant Managers, Process Owners, and Operational Staff during audits. Maintained professional communication and ensured clarity in discussions and data collection. Collaborative Issue Resolution:

Facilitated discussions with business and control owners to clarify audit findings and support remediation planning. Demonstrated strong interpersonal skills by managing sensitive issues with professionalism and diplomacy. M
Location Is the resource based in Qatar or outside? No, the resource is from Bengaluru, India. P
